attacks_not_assessable.reason: The packet holds a single readable snapshot (the Crossref abstract of one 2009/2010 study), so there is no second snapshot or guidance to compare it with. Whether newer work supersedes this study needs knowledge that is not in the stored texts, and the role file forbids asserting that from memory.

preservation.upstream_action: Repeat the same action every day in the same context for several months.
Do not treat lack of ease after two or three weeks (the '21 days' belief) as failure.
Missing a single day does not reset progress (upstream lines 4 and 5).
Bind the action to a fixed scene (when, where, which trigger), cross-reference to section item 1.
Complex behaviours (running three times a week, writing daily) were not measured, so effort after two weeks is not evidence of failure.

findings.why: The median of 66 days appears in no stored source: it is not in the Crossref abstract snapshot, which gives only the range, and not in the pinned upstream span, which also gives only the range. The only cited source that could carry it (the Wiley full text, sections Results and table 2) is blocked with status 403 and has no snapshot. A reader gets a headline figure that the stored evidence cannot support. This finding says the figure is unsupported here, not that it is wrong.

evidence.text: The time it took participants to reach 95% of their asymptote of automaticity ranged from 18 to 254 days
模型在 62 人身上拟合成功。达到各自自动化上限 95% 所需的天数，范围是 18 天到 254 天

findings.fix_direction: Support the median from a stored snapshot of the full text (Results or table 2) with the exact group it refers to, or remove it. The same applies to the mention of 66 days in the adaptation changes field.

findings.text: W tej ostatniej grupie modelowany czas osiągnięcia 95% indywidualnego poziomu automatyzmu wynosił od 18 do 254 dni
findings.why: The item restricts the 18 to 254 day range to the 39 participants with a good fit. The stored abstract does not say which group the range describes: it gives 62 fitted and 39 good fit in one sentence and the range in a later sentence without naming a group. The pinned upstream attaches the range to the 62 for whom the model fitted and never mentions 39. The item therefore changes the population of the key figure, the adaptation field presents this as a correction of group size, and the only source that could back it is blocked.

evidence.text: The model fitted for 62 individuals, of whom 39 showed a good fit
The time it took participants to reach 95% of their asymptote of automaticity ranged from 18 to 254 days
模型在 62 人身上拟合成功。达到各自自动化上限 95% 所需的天数，范围是 18 天到 254 天

findings.fix_direction: State the group exactly as a stored snapshot of the full text shows it. If no such snapshot exists, either follow what the abstract allows (range reported for participants, group not named) or record the attribution as unverified.

findings.text: Potrzebny jest wielokrotny wysiłek powtarzania wybranej czynności.
findings.why: In the study every participant carried out the behaviour daily in the same context for 12 weeks, and the 18 to 254 days are days of daily practice. The item never says daily, only 'wielokrotny', and the advice (title, W praktyce) has no frequency. A reader who links an action to a weekly or occasional event could apply the 18 to 254 day range to a dose the study did not test. The frequency and months-long horizon stated in the upstream are not carried over as a condition of the numbers.

evidence.text: chose an eating, drinking or activity behaviour to carry out daily in the same context
要的是在同一个场景下每天重复同一个动作，持续几个月

findings.fix_direction: Carry the daily-repetition condition into the cost, practice or limitations fields, and say that the study does not speak to less frequent repetition.

findings.text: Obserwuj regularność, zamiast uznawać brak automatyzmu po 21 dniach za porażkę.
findings.why: The upstream states twice that missing one opportunity does not reset or materially affect habit formation, and the abstract supports it. The item drops this entirely and does not record the omission in the adaptation changes. Advice to watch regularity, with no tolerance for a single miss, can read as a streak rule and push a reader who missed one day to give up. The item contains no unsafe instruction, so this is a dropped reassurance rather than a wrong action.

evidence.text: Missing one opportunity to perform the behaviour did not materially affect the habit formation process
中间漏掉一天，也不会把进度清零

findings.fix_direction: Restore the single-miss finding as stated in the abstract, with its scope (one missed opportunity, not repeated lapses), or record in the adaptation changes why it was omitted.

findings.text: 96 osób wybierających prosty nawyk, głównie związany z jedzeniem, piciem lub ruchem
findings.why: The abstract says each volunteer chose an eating, drinking or activity behaviour, with no 'głównie' (mainly), which suggests some chose something else. The word 'prosty' (simple) is not in the abstract; it appears only in the pinned upstream note, which is a lead and not evidence. Two scope words are therefore not backed by the stored snapshot and one hedge contradicts it.

evidence.text: chose an eating, drinking or activity behaviour to carry out daily in the same context
只有这一项研究，96 人，做的都是简单动作

findings.fix_direction: Describe the behaviours as the abstract does (eating, drinking or activity behaviour chosen by each volunteer) and mark 'simple' as taken from the upstream note unless the full text confirms it.

findings.text: Zakres 18–254 nie jest gwarancją dla każdego.
findings.why: The limitation does not say why the range is selective. The abstract links better model fit to more consistent performance, so the fitted group probably leans towards participants who performed the behaviour consistently, and participants outside the fitted group are not represented in the range. The sentence is true but leaves out the selection that the snapshot itself reports.

evidence.text: Performing the behaviour more consistently was associated with better model fit
The model fitted for 62 individuals, of whom 39 showed a good fit

findings.fix_direction: Add that model fit was associated with more consistent performance and that participants without a fitted model are outside the reported range, using only what the abstract states.

notes: Protocol: I opened only the role file, AGENTS.md, the README section 'Jak czytać dowody', the packet and the one readable snapshot 248f8ea4bd81051a.txt. The Write tool refused to overwrite the existing report without a prior Read, so I issued one Read of the output path with an offset past the end of the file; it returned no content, only a warning that the file has 144 lines, so I did not see the rejected report. The Wiley full text is blocked (403) and has no snapshot; the only evidence is the Crossref abstract. This thin source did NOT by itself cause UNAVAILABLE: the numbers, scope-words, limitations and preservation attacks were all run and produced findings from the abstract. UNAVAILABLE comes only from recency, which cannot be decided without a second snapshot or outside knowledge. Findings on 66 days and on the 39-person group say 'unsupported by the stored sources', not 'wrong'. No blocker: nothing in the item is an unsafe instruction, a Chinese rule or a legal or medical statement; no China or law leak was found. Grade attack: B for one observational study matches the README definition and the abstract supports 'self-report' and 'modelling', so no finding. Same-action: the advised action (daily repetition of a chosen behaviour in a fixed context) matches the abstract, and the desk example is labelled an adaptation in Ograniczenia#4. Figure classification: 96, 12 weeks, 82, 62, 39, 95%, 18 to 254 and 84 days are in the snapshot; 21 appears only in the upstream (line 4) and is used by the item as a popular benchmark, not as a study result; 66 is in no stored source. The 'nie mierzono ... oszczędności czasu' part of Ograniczenia#3 rests on the abstract's list of measures (daily SRHI and a record of performance) and was not flagged. Citation year: the snapshot says Year 2009 (copyright 2009) while the item and upstream cite 2010; the stored snapshot does not show the issue date, so I did not assert an error, but the orchestrator may want the year reconciled with the publisher record. The Źródła and Zmiany w adaptacji fields are not in packet.propositions, so I made no separate finding with those ids.
